Kompressorsteuerung B-CONTROL SMART Die B-CONTROL SMART ist eine leistungsstarke Kompressorsteuerung mit erweitertem Funktionsumfang, viel Speicher und IoT-Konnektivität via B-CLOUD. Sie unterstützt den Verbundbetrieb und bietet hohe Performance für anspruchsvolle Anwendungen. Wahlweise mit 3,5" Farbdisplay oder 7" Touchscreen ermöglicht sie intuitive Bedienung und sicheren Fernzugriff – eine zukunftssichere Lösung. System design The directly coupled compressor units are equipped with vibration dampers and are suitable for installation without a special foundation. The air-cooled compressor is designed for efficient heat dissipation and easy maintenance. The direct coupling provides reliable, low-maintenance power transmission between the electric motor and compressor. The automatic condensate drain ensures continuous operation by efficiently removing condensate. Compressor block Our air-cooled compressor blocks come equipped with intercoolers, an aftercooler, an oil and water separator after each compression stage, and a reliable forced-feed oil lubrication system. They provide the foundation for fully automated systems designed to compress air and gases at either atmospheric or elevated intake pressures. Oversized coolers and ribbed cylinders ensure effective heat dissipation. Ultra-fine oil filters, extended maintenance intervals, and dynamically balanced drive systems contribute to high efficiency, reliability, and smooth, low-vibration performance.

manufacturing of complete systems that have to withstand particular climatic conditions and often operate auto­nomously in the world‘s most remote places. The climatic con­ditions may vary from extremely low temperatures in winter ­and salty, moist air to high desert temperatures and sand drifts.

without the need for custom designs. Most comprehensive air and gas treatment portfolio: From separators and regenerative and adsorption dryers to refrigerated dryers, BAUER covers all air and gas purity requirements in accordance with DIN ISO 8573-1. Global market leadership & service expertise: BAUER is the global market standard in high- and medium-pressure applications across nearly all segments – with a 70% market share in breathing air systems and an undisputed leading position in industrial applications, supported by a global service network. What is the G22 series used for in helium applications? The G22 series comprises air-cooled high-pressure compressors for industrial helium compression. It is used wherever helium needs to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures or reprocessed within recovery systems, for example in industrial processes, research facilities, test benches and gas recovery plants. What performance ranges does the G22 series cover for helium? Depending on the configuration, the high-pressure versions of the G22 series achieve final pressures of up to 350 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 620 to 1,500 litres per minute, depending on the model. This makes the series suitable for both compact helium applications and high-capacity recovery and supply systems. How are the G22 high-pressure compressors controlled and monitored? The compressors are equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system.

6 The more remote and inaccessible the goal is, the bigger the role por- tability and 100% reliability play in the success of the mission. The first choice in these situations is usually the portable line from BAUER, especially the JUNIOR II, which has been tried and tested over the de- cades. If the system can be operated from a stationary ship and larger quantities of air are required, mobile systems such as the MARINER and PE-TE series are often used. They impress with a combination of great breathing air delivery in a compact size.

Der Kunde muss einen angemessenen Überwachungsmechanis- mus einrichten und aufrechterhalten, um Verhaltensweisen von Drit- ten in der nachgelagerten Handelskette (einschließlich möglicher Wiederverkäufer) aufzudecken, die den Zweck von Absatz (7) verei- teln würden.

Jeder Verstoß gegen die Absätze (7), (8) oder (9) stellt eine wesent- liche Verletzung eines wesentlichen Bestandteils dieser Vereinba- rung dar, und BAUER ist berechtigt, alle gesetzlichen Rechtsbehelfe (z. B. Schadensersatz, Unterlassungsansprüche) sowie die folgen- den vertraglich vereinbarten Rechtsbehelfe geltend zu machen: - Beendigung dieser Vereinbarung; und - für jeden Fall der Zuwiderhandlung eine vom Kunden zu zah- lende Vertragsstrafe, deren Höhe BAUER nach billigem Er- messen bestimmen kann, wobei die Angemessenheit im Streit- fall vom zuständigen Gericht überprüft wird (§ 315 BGB). Die Verpflichtung zur Zahlung einer Vertragsstrafe entfällt, wenn der Kunde den Verstoß nicht zu vertreten hat. Nach diesem Vertrag gezahlte Vertragsstrafen werden auf den Schadenser- satzanspruch von BAUER angerechnet.
